title: fMRI study of brilliant moves in the game of Go

tellings.quote: you know a study where you hook up uh somebody's brain to an fmri and they're playing the game of Go

plain: There is said to be a study in which players of the board game Go had their brains scanned by fMRI, a machine that shows brain activity, while they played. Michels brings it up himself, without naming the study or saying what it found, in an episode about children said to read minds. He raises it as a way of looking at where flashes of brilliant insight come from.
